name: AI Tools Marketer

sources.title: AI Tools for Marketers directory - 59 tools filed by marketing job
Submit Your AI Tool Free or Featured - 5-field form, badge-required free tier, $75/$145 paid tiers

conditions: Free listing requires keeping a badge or text link to aitoolsmarketer.com live on your site; the entry publishes once the badge is verified
Free entries publish 'when the queue reaches it' — no committed timeline; paid tiers ($75 Featured, $145 Featured+YouTube) are written up within two working days and need no badge
requirements: Must be a released AI tool that 'a working marketer would pay for', with published pricing and claims checkable against the vendor's own pages

Must fit one of the listed marketing jobs: AI Search & GEO, Content & Copy, Ad Creative, Media Buying, Video & Image, Social Media, CRO & Personalization, Automation & Lifecycle, Research & Intelligence
Developer tooling, consumer apps, and general business software are explicitly declined even when good
Do not send passwords, API keys, or trial credentials — everything needed must be publicly linkable
preparation: Tool URL, tool name, 'what it does' (60 chars max), marketing job category, contact email
A place on your site to embed the badge/text link (free tier)
Published pricing page — entries cite entry price and plan limits from your own pages

Decide on tier: Free (badge), $75 Featured (adds zplatform.ai profile + review, everyany.one pricing page, saasaffiliate.net listing if you run an affiliate program, founder interview), or $145 Featured video (adds YouTube review)
workflow: Open https://aitoolsmarketer.com/submit/ ('Submit a Tool' in nav)
Fill the five fields: Tool URL, Tool name, What it does (0/60), Marketing job dropdown, Email
Choose a listing tier: Free (badge required), Featured $75 one-time, or Featured video $145 one-time
Free: place the badge/link on your site — the entry publishes after the queue reaches it and the badge is verified
Paid: checkout via Dodo Payments; write-up starts within two working days; declined paid submissions are refunded in full
You receive an email with the live link either way
watchFor: ALL outbound links are nofollow on every tier including paid — this directory gives zero link equity despite the catalog 'link=follow' note; the value is the dated editorial entry
Paying changes speed and distribution, never the entry content — no editorial control at any tier
The free tier's badge obligation is ongoing ('kept live'); removing it presumably risks the listing
A declined submission is told which check it missed; paid declines are fully refunded
Nothing is ranked — the homepage table orders by when facts were last checked
countsAsLive: A public entry page exists at aitoolsmarketer.com/<slug>/ with cited pricing, plus rows in the homepage table, the marketing-job category page, /llms.txt, rss.xml and sitemap
unknowns: Free-tier queue length ('when the queue reaches it')
What happens to a published listing if the badge is later removed
